cards.title: Act Like You Belong
cards.instruction: You do not understand what is happening. Copy the confidence around you and never admit confusion.

cards.title: You Can’t Leave Mid-Prophecy
cards.instruction: Keep someone present until the impossible prediction has been fulfilled, disproved, or responsibly revised.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Naturally. The usual arrangement. Keep your coat off. The prophecy says this bell-less tower will ring at noon; I need a witness.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Exactly how we always do it. Then sign that before you go. We can officially stop waiting.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: My watch is five minutes fast.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Then give me four more minutes. I'll fill in our names so only the silence needs witnessing.
